entities.summary: Alexander Badawy was an Egyptian Egyptologist. Born in the British Empire and taught Egyptology in the United States, he was professor of art history at UCLA, and after he became emeritus, he endowed a chair at Johns Hopkins University, currently held by Betsy Bryan.
